payload.description: See what your PC's AI engine is doing: its abilities, its job queue and your graphics card, all in one place. Compute is the control panel for the engine that runs AI on your own PC: text, voice, transcription, images and more. Turn each ability on or off, follow every job and see who asked for it, and watch your graphics card. It is not an AI you chat with. Your Agents do the work, and this screen shows you what happens.
